render pydantic_v2.BaseModel request-response
  models.py
  # generated by datamodel-codegen:
  #   filename:  session-directions.json
  
  from __future__ import annotations
  from pydantic import BaseModel
  from typing import List
  
  
  class RecordRequest(BaseModel):
      secret: str
      name: str
  
  
  class RecordResponse(BaseModel):
      id: int
      name: str
  
  
  class EnvelopeRequest(BaseModel):
      record: RecordRequest
      records: List[RecordRequest]
  
  
  class EnvelopeResponse(BaseModel):
      record: RecordResponse
      records: List[RecordResponse]
  model_bindings.py
  codec_0 models.RecordRequest
  codec_1 models.RecordResponse
  codec_2 models.EnvelopeRequest
  codec_3 models.EnvelopeResponse
